title: Effect Summary Legend
summary: The purity analysis writes a short token string for every routine it judges -- symbolfacts.effectsummary in the index
intro: Read this when hover or ask effects shows a short effect string and you need to decode it. Tokens include g (touches global or external state, including SQL), h (frees heap it did not allocate), s (writes its own instance fields), p`<k`> (writes through parameter k, counted from 0) and ? (not proven: something could not be bound, which is not an effect).

steps: Choose drag-lint > Help > Effect Summary Legend
Look up the token (g, h, s, `p<k>`) shown by hover or ask effects

questions.ask: What do the letters g, h, s and `p<k>` in an effect string mean?
